title: MT. PEAK — Himalayan Tea · Sourced at Altitude
metaDesc: MT. PEAK — single-origin Himalayan tea from eastern Nepal, grown at 2,500m and plucked by hand. Three expressions: Light & Bright, Mountain Green, Golden Harvest.
heroEyebrow: From the roof of the world
manifestoLines: Most tea is grown for yield.
where thin air and cold nights force the leaf
into a single, slow, deliberate harvest.

originBlocks.p: In eastern Nepal, the garden sits at 2,500 metres. The mountain does the work no machine can: mist that slows growth, cold nights that concentrate the leaf, and a stillness you can taste in the cup.
Leaf and bud, chosen by hand rather than cut by machine. No shortcuts, no volume targets — only the standard the leaf deserves.
One origin, one garden, each tea made the same careful way every season. What we tell you about the leaf — how it was withered, rolled and dried — is exactly how it was made.

marqueeText: Single Origin — 2,500 Metres — Hand-Plucked — Eastern Nepal — Leaf & Bud — The Mountain Is Patient —
closerP: A tea grown slowly, at altitude, for those who taste the difference.
footerBlurb: Single-origin Himalayan tea, grown at altitude in eastern Nepal and plucked by hand. Sourced with intention. Crafted for ritual.
